Name: ATK_PARAM_ST
Description: Governs hitboxes and damage of attacks

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of hit 0's sphere or capsule, in metres. 0 disables hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of hit 1's sphere or capsule, in metres. 0 disables hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of hit 2's sphere or capsule, in metres. 0 disables hit 2.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of hit 3's sphere or capsule, in metres. 0 disables hit 3.

Fields.Name: Knockback Distance
Fields.Description: Distance the target is pushed back, in metres. Negative values pull it toward the attacker.

Fields.Name: Hit Stop Time
Fields.Description: Hit-stop length in seconds when this attack connects; 0 = none.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect [0]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied by this attack's hits (-1 = none). The weapon's own on-hit SpEffects are added for weapon attacks. Disable Hit SpEffect clears all of them.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect [1]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied by this attack's hits (-1 = none). See Target SpEffect [0].

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect [2]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied by this attack's hits (-1 = none). See Target SpEffect [0].

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect [3]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied by this attack's hits (-1 = none). See Target SpEffect [0].

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect [4]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied by this attack's hits (-1 = none). See Target SpEffect [0].

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Dummy Poly 1
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the centre of hit 0's sphere, or one end of its capsule. A negative value normally disables hit 0.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Dummy Poly 1
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the centre of hit 1's sphere, or one end of its capsule. A negative value normally disables hit 1.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Dummy Poly 1
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the centre of hit 2's sphere, or one end of its capsule. A negative value normally disables hit 2.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Dummy Poly 1
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the centre of hit 3's sphere, or one end of its capsule. A negative value normally disables hit 3.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Dummy Poly 2
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the other end of hit 0's capsule. -1 makes hit 0 a sphere.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Dummy Poly 2
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the other end of hit 1's capsule. -1 makes hit 1 a sphere.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Dummy Poly 2
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the other end of hit 2's capsule. -1 makes hit 2 a sphere.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Dummy Poly 2
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the other end of hit 3's capsule. -1 makes hit 3 a sphere.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Blowing
Fields.Description: Percent correction stored on the target with the hit; its later use isn't confirmed.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Physical
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's physical attack (after upgrade and scaling) this attack deals. 100 = full weapon damage. NPC attacks and Body hit-source attacks use Damage: Physical instead.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Magic
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's magic attack this attack deals. See Attack Correction: Physical.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Fire
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's fire attack this attack deals. See Attack Correction: Physical.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Lightning
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's lightning attack this attack deals. See Attack Correction: Physical.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Stamina
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's stamina attack this attack deals. The result is then scaled by the attacker's SpEffects. NPC attacks use Damage: Stamina instead.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Guard Attack Rate
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's attack repel power this attack uses against guards. A STR bonus is added on top. NPC attacks use Damage: Guard Attack Rate instead.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Guard Break
Fields.Description: Set on a player's guard rows: percent of the guarding weapon's guard repel power used when this guard blocks. A STR bonus is added on top.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Throw Escape
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's throw escape value this attack uses. NPC attacks use Damage: Throw Escape instead.

Fields.Name: Conditional Category [1]
Fields.Description: Attack category tag (0 = none). An attack can carry up to 10 tags; SpEffects that boost a category (sorcery schools, skills, charged attacks and so on) check them.

Fields.Name: Conditional Category [2]
Fields.Description: Attack category tag (0 = none). See Conditional Category [1].

Fields.Name: Damage: Physical
Fields.Description: Flat physical attack. Used by NPC attacks and by player attacks whose Hit Source Type isn't Weapon. With Is Base Attack Added, also added to a weapon attack, × the upgrade level's base attack rate.

Fields.Name: Damage: Magic
Fields.Description: Flat magic attack. See Damage: Physical.

Fields.Name: Damage: Fire
Fields.Description: Flat fire attack. See Damage: Physical.

Fields.Name: Damage: Lightning
Fields.Description: Flat lightning attack. See Damage: Physical.

Fields.Name: Damage: Stamina
Fields.Description: Flat stamina attack. Used by NPC attacks; with Is Base Attack Added, also added to a weapon attack's stamina attack. Scaled by the attacker's SpEffects.

Fields.Name: Damage: Guard Attack Rate
Fields.Description: Flat attack repel power against guards. Used by NPC attacks; with Is Base Attack Added, also added to a weapon attack's repel power.

Fields.Name: Damage: Guard Break Rate
Fields.Description: NPCs only. Value used to determine if an attack is repelled

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus Hit SFX Variant
Fields.Description: Which SFX plays at the hit when its poise damage gets a bonus: 0 = GameSystemCommonParam Poise Bonus Hit SFX (Variant 0), 1 = Poise Bonus Hit SFX (Variant 1), other values = none. Retail: 1 on 2 rows (Fire's Deadly Sin - Flame Aura), 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Damages Bush-Break Assets
Fields.Description: Lets this attack damage assets that only break from bush damage.

Fields.Name: Damage: Throw Escape
Fields.Description: Flat throw escape value for NPC attacks.

Fields.Name: Damage: Object
Fields.Description: Damage dealt to breakable assets.

Fields.Name: Guard Cut Stamina Rate
Fields.Description: Set on guard rows: multiplies the guard's stamina damage cut by (100 + value)/100; the result stays within 0–100%. 0 = unchanged.

Fields.Name: Guard Rate
Fields.Description: Set on guard rows: multiplies the guard's damage cut rates by (100 + value)/100. 0 = unchanged, -100 = no guard cut, 100 = double.

Fields.Name: Throw Type ID
Fields.Description: The throw this attack starts (with Throw Flag 1 or 3): the ThrowParam row whose Throw Type ID equals this value, for the attacker and defender character IDs.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the weapon hit 0 represents. 0 Tip, 1 Middle and 2 Root pick the matching Hit Rumble ID; 3 is for map collision. 2 and 3 can also trigger an attacker reaction when they connect.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the weapon hit 1 represents. See Hit 0: Hit Type.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the weapon hit 2 represents. See Hit 0: Hit Type.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the weapon hit 3 represents. See Hit 0: Hit Type.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Priority
Fields.Description: priority. If there are two or more hits at the same time, the one with the higher priority will be adopted.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Priority
Fields.Description: priority. If there are two or more hits at the same time, the one with the higher priority will be adopted.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Priority
Fields.Description: priority. If there are two or more hits at the same time, the one with the higher priority will be adopted.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Priority
Fields.Description: priority. If there are two or more hits at the same time, the one with the higher priority will be adopted.

Fields.Name: Damage Level
Fields.Description: The damage reaction (stagger) the target plays. Against players, Damage Level - Vs. Player replaces it when set.

Fields.Name: Map Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which collision filter the hitboxes use against the map and assets. 3 behaves like 0.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Bypass Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplies the defender's guard cut by (100 + value)/100, from -100 to 100. 0 = normal, -100 = guard cut ignored, 100 = double. -50 turns a 100% guard into 50%.

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute
Fields.Description: Physical damage type (slash, strike, pierce, standard). 253 and 252 take the weapon's first or second type.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: Element of the attack. 255 takes the weapon's element and its variation value.

Fields.Name: Attack Type
Fields.Description: Hit effect type: picks the Slash, Blow, Thrust or Neutral hit SFX group and the hit sound. Values outside 0–3 play no hit SFX unless a bullet overrides them.

Fields.Name: Attack Material
Fields.Description: Attacker material: picks the hit SFX concept column. 255 takes the weapon's material; 254 plays no SFX.

Fields.Name: Guard Range Type
Fields.Description: Where the guard check looks from: 0 the attack's owner, 1 the hit's contact point. Use 1 for attacks that land far from their owner.

Fields.Name: Defence SE Material [1]
Fields.Description: Set on guard rows: the sound material of a blocked hit, slot 1. 255 uses the guarding weapon's material (players).

Fields.Name: Hit Source Type
Fields.Description: Where the hit dummy polys come from: 0 the weapon, 1 the character's body. For player attacks, any value other than 0 also switches damage to the flat Damage values.

Fields.Name: Throw Flag
Fields.Description: 0 ordinary attack; 1 starts the Throw Type ID throw on an unguarded hit; 2 is throw damage (throw-only SpEffect changes apply); 3 starts the throw and keeps its own damage level.

Fields.Name: Disable Guard
Fields.Description: The attack can't be guarded.

Fields.Name: Disable Stamina Attack
Fields.Description: The guard-break check still uses the stamina attack, but no stamina is taken.

Fields.Name: Disable Hit SpEffect
Fields.Description: The hits apply no SpEffects at all: neither this row's nor the weapon's.

Fields.Name: Disable Missed Attack Notification For AI
Fields.Description: Do not notify AI of missed swing

Fields.Name: Repeat Hit Sound FX
Fields.Description: Changes whether repeated hits on a wall play the hit SFX again.

Fields.Name: Is Physical Projectile
Fields.Description: Marks a projectile (arrow, bolt) attack; body parts can take a different damage rate from projectiles.

Fields.Name: Is Attack By Ghost
Fields.Description: Marks the hit as a spirit attack, which also makes it unguardable in most cases.

Fields.Name: Disable No Damage
Fields.Description: Hits through the target's no-damage states, such as dodge invincibility. Full invincibility still blocks it.

Fields.Name: Hit SFX Strength
Fields.Description: Picks the HitEffectSfxParam column within the Hit Effect Type group: 0 Normal, 1 S, 2 L, 3 Special 1, 4 Special 2. Other values play no SFX.

Fields.Name: Hit SFX Direction
Fields.Description: Added to the HitEffectSfxConceptParam cell to pick the HitEffectSfxParam row (0-4). If that row doesn't exist, the cell's own row is used.

Fields.Name: Oppose Target
Fields.Description: The attack can hit hostile characters.

Fields.Name: Friendly Target
Fields.Description: The attack can hit allied characters.

Fields.Name: Self Target
Fields.Description: The attack can hit its own owner.

Fields.Name: Is Target Hit Through Door
Fields.Description: Checks whether the target is behind a door before the hit lands.

Fields.Name: Is Mounted Attack
Fields.Description: Mounted attack: its poise damage is multiplied by GameSystemCommonParam's mounted-attack poise rate (one for player targets, one for enemies).

Fields.Name: Is Base Attack Added
Fields.Description: Adds the flat Damage values (attack, stamina, poise, repel) to a weapon attack. The flat attack is × the upgrade level's base attack rate.

Fields.Name: Is Excluded from Threat Level Notification
Fields.Description: Hostile-targeting attacks normally flag their owner as a threat; set to exclude this attack.

Fields.Name: Use Hero Level Attack Rate
Fields.Description: On: the attack's power is multiplied by the attacker's hero-level attack rates (HeroStatusParam Attack Correction and Attack Correction (Sub)), mixed by Hero Attack Rate Mix. Off: no hero-level multiplier. Retail: on for almost every row.

Fields.Name: Attack Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Tag for behaviour scripts, which test it to pick damage reactions. No effect by itself. Most player attacks use 9 (combo hits use the chain recovery).

Fields.Name: Hit SE Strength
Fields.Description: Strength of the hit sound.

Fields.Name: Damage: Poise
Fields.Description: Flat poise damage. Used by NPC attacks; with Is Base Attack Added, also added to a weapon attack's poise damage. Scaled by the attacker's SpEffects.

Fields.Name: Decal ID [1]
Fields.Description: Decal placed directly on hit (DecalParam row, -1 = none).

Fields.Name: Decal ID [2]
Fields.Description: Second decal placed directly on hit (DecalParam row, -1 = none).

Fields.Name: Appear AI Sound ID
Fields.Description: AI sound emitted when the attack starts (0 = none).

Fields.Name: Hit AI Sound ID
Fields.Description: AI sound emitted when the attack hits (0 = none).

Fields.Name: Hit Rumble ID - Default
Fields.Description: Controller rumble on hit (-1 = none). Used when the hit type's own rumble ID is -1, and for hit type 3.

Fields.Name: Hit Rumble ID - Normal
Fields.Description: Controller rumble when a Tip (0) hit connects (-1 = use Hit Rumble ID - Default).

Fields.Name: Hit Rumble ID - Middle
Fields.Description: Controller rumble when a Middle (1) hit connects (-1 = use Hit Rumble ID - Default).

Fields.Name: Hit Rumble ID - Root
Fields.Description: Controller rumble when a Root (2) hit connects (-1 = use Hit Rumble ID - Default).

Fields.Name: Defence SFX Material [1]
Fields.Description: Set on guard rows: the hit SFX material (HitEffectSfxConceptParam row) of a blocked hit, slot 1. 255 uses the guarding weapon's material (players).

Fields.Name: Defence SE Material [2]
Fields.Description: Set on guard rows: the sound material of a blocked hit, slot 2. 255 uses the guarding weapon's second material.

Fields.Name: Defence SFX Material [2]
Fields.Description: Set on guard rows: the hit SFX material of a blocked hit, slot 2; both slots play. 255 uses the guarding weapon's second material.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Holy
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's holy attack this attack deals. See Attack Correction: Physical.

Fields.Name: Damage: Holy
Fields.Description: Flat holy attack. See Damage: Physical.

Fields.Name: Disable Parry
Fields.Description: The attack can't be parried. 0 lets a defender in a parry state parry it.

Fields.Name: Is Disable 2H ATK Bonus
Fields.Description: Two-handing doesn't raise STR (×1.5) for this attack's scaling.

Fields.Name: Is Invalidated by No Damage in Air
Fields.Description: The target's airborne no-damage state blocks this attack. Ignored when Disable No Damage is set.

Fields.Name: Is Invalidated by Special Invincibility
Fields.Description: Set: the attack does no damage to a target in a special invincible state (a target with PlayerCommonParam Special Invincibility SpEffect, or under a matching animation flag). Works like Is Invalidated by No Damage in Air; with Is Disable No Damage set, the animation-flag state still blocks it. Retail: set on most player attacks (8,912 of 8,988 Pc rows).
Padding.

Fields.Name: Damage Level - Vs. Player
Fields.Description: Damage reaction used instead of Damage Level when the target is a player. 0 = use Damage Level. Uses the SpEffect damage-level numbering: 1 None, 2 Minimum, 3 Short, 4 Medium, 5 Long, and so on.

Fields.Name: Status Ailment Correction
Fields.Description: Percent applied to the status build-up of the SpEffects this attack applies (those that allow status correction), including the weapon's. 100 = unchanged.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Correction: Flat Attack
Fields.Description: Percent scaling of the flat attack bonuses from the attacker's SpEffects (those that allow attack correction) on this attack. 100 = full effect.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Correction: Attack Rate
Fields.Description: Percent scaling of the attack-rate multipliers from the attacker's SpEffects (those that allow attack correction) on this attack. 100 = full effect.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Correction: Damage Rate
Fields.Description: Percent scaling of the damage-rate multipliers from the attacker's SpEffects (those that allow attack correction) on this attack. 100 = full effect.

Fields.Name: Attack Behavior ID [2]
Fields.Description: A second behaviour script tag; works like Attack Behavior ID, so an attack can carry two.

Fields.Name: Throw Damage Attribute
Fields.Description: With Throw Flag 2 (throw damage): 1 applies the target's SpEffect throw-damage modifiers to this hit.

Fields.Name: Status Ailment Correction - By Point
Fields.Description: Extra percent for the status build-up of this row's own Target SpEffects, on top of Status Ailment Correction. 100 = unchanged.

Fields.Name: Attack Element Correct Override
Fields.Description: AttackElementCorrectParam row used for this attack's scaling instead of the weapon's (-1 = the weapon's).

Fields.Name: Decal Base ID [1]
Fields.Description: Base of a decal chosen by the material of the hit surface (-1 = none).

Fields.Name: Decal Base ID [2]
Fields.Description: Base of a second decal chosen by the material of the hit surface (-1 = none).

Fields.Name: Weapon HP Regain Amount Scale
Fields.Description: Percent of the weapon's HP regain (rally) value this attack gives. The total is × the attacker's SpEffect regain rate, and reduced when guarded.

Fields.Name: Attack HP Regain Amount
Fields.Description: Flat HP regain (rally) added to the weapon's.

Fields.Name: HP Regain Time Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplies how long the HP this hit takes stays regainable by the target.

Fields.Name: HP Regain Rate Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplies how much of the HP this hit takes the target can regain.

Fields.Name: HP Regain Same-Attack ID
Fields.Description: Hits sharing an ID (0 or more) count as one attack for the target's regainable-HP record (-1 = none).

Fields.Name: Special Attribute VFX Variation Offset
Fields.Description: Variation offset for the hit SFX and sound of the element. Replaced by the weapon's when Special Attribute is 255.

Fields.Name: Parry Forward Offset
Fields.Description: Offset in degrees to the attacker's forward angle in the parry check.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Poise
Fields.Description: Weapon attacks only: percent of the weapon's poise damage (after upgrade) this attack deals. NPC attacks use Damage: Poise instead.

Fields.Name: Defence SFX Material Variation Offset
Fields.Description: Set on guard rows: variation offset for the blocked-hit SFX and sound.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute for Magic Cocktail
Fields.Description: Override for purposes of Magic Cocktail affinity residue

Fields.Name: Hero Attack Rate Mix %
Fields.Description: With Use Hero Level Attack Rate on: the percentage of the multiplier taken from HeroStatusParam Attack Correction; the rest (100 minus this) comes from its Attack Correction (Sub). Retail: 100 on every row, and both rates are 1, so the multiplier is 1.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Ultimate Art
Fields.Description: The correction for ultimate art gauge charge.

Fields.Name: Damage: Poise - Deflected
Fields.Description: Poise damage to self when this attack is deflected.

Fields.Name: Revive Damage %
Fields.Description: Percentage of the weapon's Revive Damage this attack deals to a downed ally's revive progress (100: the weapon's value). Without a weapon, the attack's own Revive Damage is used instead.

Fields.Name: Damage: Revive
Fields.Description: Flat amount of revive damage.

Fields.Name: Override Aggro Value
Fields.Description: Aggro value that overrides the default one during calculation.

Fields.Description: Subcategory 3

Fields.Description: Subcategory 4

Fields.Description: Subcategory 5

Fields.Name: Allow SpEffect Weapon Type Conditions
Fields.Description: On: SpEffects that only apply to attacks of certain weapon types check the weapon behind this attack. Off: such SpEffects never apply to it. Retail: on for every row.
